title: Week 1 Quiz: FANBOYS and Subordinating Conjunctions
summary: 20 questions · 20 minutes. Do it alone, without notes, then upload a screenshot of your score to Google Classroom.

blocks.title: Before you start
items: Do the quiz alone, without your notes.
You have 20 minutes. The timer starts when you press Start.
At the end, take a screenshot of your score and upload it to the quiz assignment on Google Classroom.

blocks.title: Week 1 Quiz: FANBOYS and Subordinating Conjunctions

questions.q: The sky was dark, ___ we took our umbrellas.
We took our umbrellas, ___ the sky was dark.
He is very rich, ___ he is never happy.
She can't sing, ___ can she dance.
Finish your dinner, ___ you won't get dessert.
Which sentence is correct?
c: The teacher smiled and, said hello.
The teacher, smiled and said hello.
The teacher smiled, and said hello.
The teacher smiled and said hello.

questions.q: Which sentence is correct?
c: The teacher smiled and, the students relaxed.
The teacher smiled, and, the students relaxed.
The teacher smiled and the students relaxed.
The teacher smiled, and the students relaxed.

questions.q: Which is a comma splice?
c: I was late, so I ran.
Because I was late, I ran.

questions.q: He didn't call, nor ___.
___ the film was long, nobody left the cinema.
I won't go out ___ I finish my homework.
___ you water the plants, they will die.
We have lived in Maadi ___ 2019.
He trained every day ___ he could join the team.
Which is correct?
c: If it rains we will stay home.
If it rains, we will stay home.
If, it rains we will stay home.
We will stay home, if it rains.

questions.q: Which is correct?
c: Although she was tired she worked, but.
She was tired, although but she worked.
Although she was tired, but she worked.
Although she was tired, she worked.

questions.q: Which is a fragment?
c: When the lesson started, we sat down.

questions.q: I'll call you when I ___ home.
Egypt is hot in summer, ___ the UK is usually cool. (comparing two facts)
Studies show ___ exercise improves memory.
